section_title: Prohibited acts including causing, permitting or suffering.
body_text:
Whenever in this code any act or omission is made unlawful, it shall include causing,
permitting, aiding, abetting, suffering or concealing the fact of such act or omission.
(Ord. 2422-92 § 1)
